title: Revised Code of Washington, Title 48 (Insurance), Chapter 48.30 - Unfair Practices and Frauds
verified_how: fetched https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=48.30 (HTTP 200): breadcrumb 'Home / State laws and rules / RCWs / Title 48 / Chapter 48.30', heading 'Chapter 48.30 RCW - UNFAIR PRACTICES AND FRAUDS', with 'Complete chapter' HTML and PDF links, an 'RCW dispositions' link and a full section list. Currency: the RCW index page (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/) states 'Last update: July 15, 2026' and explains that 'The online version of the RCW is updated twice a year, once in the early fall following the legislative session, and again at the end of the year if a ballot measure that changes the law passed at the general election'; it also records that 'The Statute Law Committee declares that the certified PDF publication documents in the RCW Archive area on the Office of the Code Reviser's website constitute the official publication of the Revised Code of Washington', so this HTML version is the working rather than the certified text. The register flags amended-but-not-yet-merged text by printing a section two or three times with '(as amended by 2026 c NN)' suffixes.
notes: This chapter carries both the general unfair-practices prohibition (RCW 48.30.010) and the Insurance Fair Conduct Act cause of action for unreasonable denial of a claim (RCW 48.30.015). The itemised unfair claim settlement practices are in Insurance Commissioner regulation (WAC 284-30) rather than statute.
